in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is present in the presence of gods, the one who is present in this moment and can be seen, the one who is present in our eyes

in_marathi.name: Darshit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seen, Beheld, Visible
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darshit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘darsh’, meaning ‘to see’. vedic_reference.note: The name Darshit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Darshan', which means 'to see, to view, to observe'. In Hindu mythology, Darshan is considered as an essential part of the spiritual practice, as it is believed that seeing the divine form of the deity brings blessings and purifies the mind. Darshit is also mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas.
